definitions.explanation: A gesture of respect made by bending the body.

examples.japanese: {深|ふか}い{礼|れい}をして{挨拶|あいさつ}した。
examples.english: I greeted them with a deep bow.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}に{礼|れい}をしてから{教室|きょうしつ}を{出|で}た。
examples.english: I bowed to the teacher before leaving the classroom.

examples.japanese: {試合|しあい}の{前|まえ}に{相手|あいて}に{礼|れい}をする。
examples.english: You bow to your opponent before the match.

examples.japanese: {社長|しゃちょう}が{入|はい}ってきたら{礼|れい}をしてください。
examples.english: Please bow when the president comes in.

examples.japanese: お{礼|れい}に{何|なに}かプレゼントを{送|おく}りたい。
examples.english: I want to send something as thanks.

examples.japanese: {助|たす}けてもらったお{礼|れい}を{忘|わす}れないでください。
examples.english: Please don't forget to thank them for helping you.

examples.japanese: お{礼|れい}の{手紙|てがみ}を{書|か}きました。
これはお{礼|れい}の{気持|きも}ちです。
examples.english: This is a token of my gratitude.

examples.japanese: {礼儀|れいぎ}を{知|し}らない{人|ひと}は{嫌|きら}われます。
examples.english: People who don't know manners are disliked.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{礼|れい}を{学|まな}びたいです。
examples.english: I want to learn Japanese etiquette.

examples.japanese: {礼|れい}を{尽|つ}くして{お願|おねが}いした。
examples.english: I asked with the utmost courtesy.

examples.japanese: {礼|れい}に{欠|か}ける{態度|たいど}だった。
examples.english: It was an attitude lacking in manners.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{礼|れい}を{重|おも}んじる{人|ひと}だ。
examples.english: He is a person who values etiquette.

notes:
{礼|れい} covers bowing and gratitude.

EXPRESSIONS:
- お{礼|れい}: thanks, reward
- {礼|れい}を{言|い}う: to thank
- {礼|れい}を{尽|つ}くす: to show proper respect

COMPOUNDS:
- {礼儀|れいぎ}: manners, courtesy
- {失礼|しつれい}: rudeness, excuse me
- {敬礼|けいれい}: salute
- {無礼|ぶれい}: rudeness
